issues.description: The specification/UML defines `lectureName` as a `String`, but the solution declares it as `private LectureName lectureName;` and introduces an additional `LectureName` class. This contradicts the required data model and will mislead students implementing a String-based field as instructed.
issues.suggestedFix: Align to the spec by changing the solution field to `private String lectureName;` and removing `LectureName.java` (or, alternatively, update the problem statement/UML/template to explicitly require `LectureName` everywhere).

issues.description: The required `Lecture` constructor should take `lectureName` as a `String` (per UML/spec), but the solution constructor takes `LectureName lectureName`, changing the constructor signature students are told to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution constructor to `public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors)` to match the spec (or update all artifacts to consistently use `LectureName`).

issues.description: In the solution, `getLectureName()` is declared to return `String` but returns the field `lectureName` which is declared as `LectureName`. This is internally inconsistent and will not compile, making the reference solution unusable.
issues.suggestedFix: Either (preferred) change the field to `String lectureName` to match the spec, or change the getter to return `LectureName` (or return `lectureName.toString()`/`lectureName.getValue()` consistently) and update the specification accordingly.

issues.description: In the solution, `setLectureName(String lectureName)` assigns a `String` to the field `lectureName` which is declared as `LectureName`, causing a type error and preventing compilation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the setter consistent with the field: either use `String lectureName` for the field, or change the setter to `setLectureName(LectureName lectureName)` (or wrap the string: `this.lectureName = new LectureName(lectureName);`) and update the spec/template accordingly.
